aurvek_infrastructure_enterprise_grade_a: Aurvek Infrastructure - Enterprise-grade architecture with multi-layer security, zero-origin exposure through Cloudflare Tunnel, and global edge distribution.
ai_infrastructure_enterprise_security_cl: AI infrastructure, enterprise security, Cloudflare Tunnel, FastAPI, nginx, edge computing, DDoS protection
aurvek_infrastructure_enterprise_archite: Aurvek Infrastructure - Enterprise Architecture, Open Source Spirit
multi_layer_security_global_edge_distrib: Multi-layer security, global edge distribution, and zero-origin exposure. The engineering behind Aurvek.
Multi-layer security, global edge distribution, and zero-origin exposure. The infrastructure behind Aurvek was built with the same standards we'd expect from the platforms we admire.
security_isn_t_a_feature_it_s: Security isn't a feature. It's the foundation.
four_independent_layers_of_protection_ea: Four independent layers of protection, each unaware of the others' existence. An attacker would need to bypass all of them in sequence.
ddos_mitigation_web_application_firewall: DDoS mitigation, Web Application Firewall, bot management, and TLS termination at 300+ global points of presence.
rate_limiting_r_s_general_r_s: Rate limiting (10r/s general, 50r/s static, 5r/s auth), security headers, scanner detection, and static file serving.
malicious_pattern_detection_with_instant: Malicious pattern detection with instant blocking, 404 accumulation tracking, and real IP resolution through proxy chains.
jwt_authentication_role_based_access_con: JWT authentication, role-based access control, permission validation, and input sanitization at every endpoint.
wordpress_probes_php_shells_cloud_metada: WordPress probes, PHP shells, cloud metadata attacks, and path traversal attempts are blocked on first request. 24-hour ban, no exceptions.
suspicious_s_in_minutes_triggers_automat: 10 suspicious 404s in 3 minutes triggers automatic blocking. Legitimate crawlers get more lenience (50 requests) because we recognize them.
we_see_through_proxy_chains_cf_connectin: We see through proxy chains. CF-Connecting-IP, X-Forwarded-For parsing, direct connection fallback. You can't hide behind proxies.
our_servers_don_t_exist_on_the: Our servers don't exist on the public internet.
zero_inbound_ports_no_exposed_ip_address: Zero inbound ports. No exposed IP addresses. Traffic flows through encrypted Cloudflare Tunnels. Attackers can't target what they can't find.
origin_servers_are_invisible_to_port_sca: Origin servers are invisible to port scanners and reconnaissance tools
tls_between_cloudflare_edge_and_origin_t: TLS 1.3 between Cloudflare edge and origin through the tunnel
tunnel_reconnects_transparently_on_netwo: Tunnel reconnects transparently on network issues without dropping requests
no_ports_to_open_no_rules_to: No ports to open, no rules to maintain, no attack surface to harden
static_content_never_touches_our_servers: Static content never touches our servers.
assets_are_cached_at_cloudflare_edge_loc: Assets are cached at 300+ Cloudflare edge locations. Users download from the nearest node, often in under 20ms.
static_files_served_directly_by_nginx_ze: Static files served directly by nginx. Zero application overhead. Rate-limited at 50 requests/second per IP to prevent abuse.
day_browser_cache_automatic_webp_convers: 30-day browser cache. Automatic WebP conversion. Brotli compression. Images, CSS, JS, and fonts served from the nearest edge node.
traffic_routed_through_cloudflare_s_priv: Traffic routed through Cloudflare's private backbone, avoiding congested internet paths. Faster and more reliable than public routing.
no_bleeding_edge_experiments_battle_test: No bleeding-edge experiments. Battle-tested tools, configured correctly.
every_security_layer_every_configuration: Every security layer, every configuration, every line of code is available for inspection. We believe the best security is security that can be audited.
